pages.title: Page 1 - Session Opening
pages.text: Agenda 1. Call to order. Chair confirms quorum and opens the session.$(br2)Agenda 2. Approval of prior minutes pending legal review of redactions.$(br2)Agenda 3. Budget overview presented by finance covering Mars deployment costs.$(br2)Agenda 4. Operations report submitted on schedule by infrastructure division.

pages.title: Page 2 - Infrastructure
pages.text: Agenda 1. Atmospheric stabilization update. Polar arrays remain in standby configuration.$(br2)Agenda 2. Colonial holdings revenue lagging projection across three fiscal quarters.$(br2)Agenda 3. Legal exposure summary noting external counsel recommendations.$(br2)Agenda 4. Kinetic launch corridor secured for next manifest cycle.

pages.title: Page 3 - Operations
pages.text: Agenda 1. Security audit of facility blackglass inventory with chain of custody appendix.$(br2)Agenda 2. Geothermal damper diagnostics returned within nominal operating bands.$(br2)Agenda 3. Labor cohort selection criteria revised for technical and breeding classes.$(br2)Agenda 4. Atmospheric injection station readiness verified by mission engineering.

pages.title: Page 4 - Continuity
pages.text: Agenda 1. Settler manifest expansion approved subject to financial guarantee adjustments.$(br2)Agenda 2. Strategic continuity provisions reviewed and accepted without objection.$(br2)Agenda 3. Closing remarks delivered by chair noting deniability requirements.$(br2)Agenda 4. Adjournment recorded at standard timestamp with attendance confirmed.

pages.title: Directive 7-C
pages.text: Distributed copies were to be returned to Records following adjournment.$(br2)Annotations in $(italic)non-archival ink$() are prohibited under directive 7-C.$(br2)That warning does not read like a formality. It reads like someone expected the margins to matter.
